Return to [home page](/) or [about page](/about).

Inspired from Silvia Canelón's [commitment to accessibility](https://silviacanelon.com/accessibility) The South West Insights and Intelligence Team welcomes feedback on the accessibility of this site and any links to its materials including code and training materials.
We have used the [Web Accessibility Evaluation Tool](https://wave.webaim.org/) to manually check for accessibility errors and corrected where possible.

# Reporting accessibility problems with this website

We are always looking to improve the accessibility of this website. Please let us know if you find any problems not listed on this page or if we are not meeting accessibility requirements, email [england.swinsightsandintelligence@nhs.net](mailto:england.swinsightsandintelligence@nhs.net).

## Website practices

This site has been designed with the following features in mind:

- The colour palette is from [NHS branding](https://www.england.nhs.uk/nhsidentity/identity-guidelines/colours/).
- Fonts are set to Arial which is an [NHS font](https://www.england.nhs.uk/nhsidentity/identity-guidelines/fonts/).
- Alternative text is used for all images.

Any learning will be used to improve the site and will also be shared with the community more widely through book resources like the [Open Analytics page](https://resources.nhsrcommunity.com/accessibility.html) where we have started to contribute links that support greater Accessibility.

# Non-accessible content

## Search button

This is generated automatically through rendering a Quarto website and appears as an empty button. 

There is an open [issue](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/678) on Quarto's GitHub.

## Missing level headers

There are elements on the pages where first and second level heading is missing.

## YouTube video links

If there are links to YouTube videos in this website, they currently only have the automated YouTube subtitles.

## Event handlers may not be accessible

This website has used JavaScript events in Quarto and may not be accessible to both mouse and keyboard users.
